run_predict_location_language: run the TalkTheWalk language model training to predict tourist location from dialogue utterances
run_eval_epoch: run eval_epoch to evaluate a GuideLanguage model on a data loader and return loss and accuracy
run_get_mean_T: run get_mean_T to compute the mean predicted trajectory length distribution from a guide model
train_guide_language_model: train a GuideLanguage model on TalkTheWalk dataset with configurable embedding size, hidden size, and epochs
evaluate_guide_model: evaluate a saved GuideLanguage model on test data and compute mean trajectory length predictions
